Unit Test Coverage Helper v0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill.
- Provides structured guidance for improving unit test coverage in existing codebases.
- Outlines a repeatable workflow for adding and validating unit tests.
- Includes checklists, implementation suggestions, and verification steps tailored for software maintainers, QA teams, and contributors.
- Triggered by keywords related to testing and code quality.
